faq.a: A food tour is a fun and exciting walking tour in which you get to learn about the city, it's history, culture, as well as visit 5-7 locally owned restaurants that serve fresh cuisine. Come Experience Columbia or Lexington, One Bite at a Time. It is a must for anyone visiting the Midlands and for locals, alike! Where does the tour begin?
